response.rationale: R4 is preferred over R3 due to the presence of a complex cystic mass with internal calcifications and mural nodularity, which is more characteristic of Mucinous Cystic Neoplasm (MCN).

rejected.why: Serous Cystadenoma typically has a microcystic or macrocystic appearance without mural nodularity.
Solid Pseudopapillary Neoplasm (SPN) is less likely due to the absence of characteristic radiological features such as a well-defined capsule and degenerative cystic changes.
Pancreatic Cancer is less likely due to the absence of solid components and the presence of a well-defined cystic lesion.
